help.short: The workspace name of Azure Managed Grafana.

description: List all managed private endpoints of a grafana resource.

operations.description: List all managed private endpoints of a grafana resource.

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

params.description: The workspace name of Azure Managed Grafana.
params.name: workspaceName

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: The geo-location where the resource lives
props.name: location

props.description: The name of the resource
props.name: name

props.description: Resource properties.
props.name: properties

props.description: The state of managed private endpoint connection.
props.name: connectionState

props.description: Gets or sets the reason for approval/rejection of the connection.
props.name: description

props.description: The approval/rejection status of managed private endpoint connection.
props.name: status

props.description: The group Ids of the managed private endpoint.
props.name: groupIds

props.description: The ARM resource ID of the resource for which the managed private endpoint is pointing to.
props.name: privateLinkResourceId

props.description: The region of the resource to which the managed private endpoint is pointing to.
props.name: privateLinkResourceRegion

props.description: The private IP of private endpoint after approval. This property is empty before connection is approved.
props.name: privateLinkServicePrivateIP

props.description: The URL of the data store behind the private link service. It would be the URL in the Grafana data source configuration page without the protocol and port.
props.name: privateLinkServiceUrl

props.description: Provisioning state of the resource.
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: User input request message of the managed private endpoint.
props.name: requestMessage

props.description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.
props.name: systemData

props.description: The timestamp of resource creation (UTC).
props.name: createdAt

props.description: The identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdBy

props.description: The type of identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdByType

props.description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
props.name: lastModifiedAt

props.description: The identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedBy

props.description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedByType

props.description: Resource tags.
props.name: tags

props.description: The type of the resource. E.g. "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines" or "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts"
props.name: type
